messages:
emma: Quick sync — PR #5102 updates the rate/quota page but needs a concise example showing how tiered metering affects billing alerts. Can someone add a sample alert rule + tiny JS SDK snippet?
kai: I can add the alert rule. Do we want an example that triggers on percent-of-daily-allowance or tokens-per-minute? Ops prefers percent-of-daily.
emma: Percent-of-daily is clearer for customers. Show a 80% threshold example and include a note about burst credits not counted against the daily percent until consumed.
harpreet: I'll add a compact JS snippet that queries the usage API and computes pct used. Keep it 6–8 lines. Also note that timestamps are UTC.
emma: Good — also include a one-sentence migration note: "If you migrated from the legacy meter header, map it to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute allowances using reported per_day."
docs-bot: Reminder: add unit tests for code examples? Docs lint flags inline code that won't run.
kai: Alert rule (draft):
```
when: usage.percent_of_daily >= 80
window: 1h
action: notify.billing-team
notes: excludes unconsumed burst credits
```
harpreet: JS snippet:```js
// fetch daily allowance and usage, compute percent
const tier = await client.getUsageTier('pro');
const used = await client.getUsage({range: 'today'});
const pct = Math.round((used.tokens / tier.per_day) * 100);
console.log(`${pct}% used`);
```
emma: Add a short UX callout: "Percent calculations round to nearest whole percent for alerts; enforcement still uses integer token math."
design-bot: Docs style: prefer `per_day` key in code blocks and avoid company-internal endpoints. Replace any internal URLs with /docs links.
kai: I'll remove internal links and link to /docs/usage-alerts panel instead.
emma: Action items: kai — finalize alert YAML and update the PR; harpreet — add JS snippet and a Python one-liner for the curl example; i'll run a quick pass after docs-bot l10n. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
